necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heartbeats, raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. To characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, a 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated. This 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) was medically necessary to address the specific clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
